suites.title: DQ-1 Book Store accounts - create a user, get a token, sign in and sign out

specs.title: SCN-001: A client creates a user with a policy-compliant password and gets 201 with the new user

steps.title: Given a unique user name and the password from DQ_USER_PASSWORD
When I POST /Account/v1/User with that user name and password
Then the response status is 201
And the body contains a userID that is a UUID
And the body username equals the requested user name
And the body books is an empty list

specs.title: SCN-002.1: A password that breaks the policy is rejected and no account is created (too short)

steps.title: Given a unique user name
When I POST /Account/v1/User with the password "<password>" that is too short
Then the response status is 400
And the error code is "1300"
And the error message is the password-policy message
And a token cannot be obtained for that user name and password

specs.title: SCN-002.2: A password that breaks the policy is rejected and no account is created (missing an uppercase)

steps.title: Given a unique user name
When I POST /Account/v1/User with the password "<password>" that is missing an uppercase
Then the response status is 400
And the error code is "1300"
And the error message is the password-policy message
And a token cannot be obtained for that user name and password

specs.title: SCN-002.3: A password that breaks the policy is rejected and no account is created (missing a lowercase)

steps.title: Given a unique user name
When I POST /Account/v1/User with the password "<password>" that is missing a lowercase
Then the response status is 400
And the error code is "1300"
And the error message is the password-policy message
And a token cannot be obtained for that user name and password

specs.title: SCN-002.4: A password that breaks the policy is rejected and no account is created (missing a digit)

steps.title: Given a unique user name
When I POST /Account/v1/User with the password "<password>" that is missing a digit
Then the response status is 400
And the error code is "1300"
And the error message is the password-policy message
And a token cannot be obtained for that user name and password

specs.title: SCN-002.5: A password that breaks the policy is rejected and no account is created (missing a special char)

steps.title: Given a unique user name
When I POST /Account/v1/User with the password "<password>" that is missing a special char
Then the response status is 400
And the error code is "1300"
And the error message is the password-policy message
And a token cannot be obtained for that user name and password

specs.title: SCN-014.1: The 8-character minimum length is enforced exactly at the boundary (7 chars)

steps.title: Given a unique user name
When I POST /Account/v1/User with a password of 7 characters containing every required character class
Then the account is rejected

specs.title: SCN-014.2: The 8-character minimum length is enforced exactly at the boundary (8 chars)

steps.title: Given a unique user name
When I POST /Account/v1/User with a password of 8 characters containing every required character class
Then the account is accepted

specs.title: SCN-003: Creating a user whose user name already exists is rejected with 406

steps.title: Given a user was created through the API
[SEED] account (POST /Account/v1/User)
When I POST /Account/v1/User again with the same user name
Then the response status is 406
And the error code is "1204"
And the error message is "User exists!"

specs.title: SCN-004.1: Creating a user without a user name or without a password is rejected with 400 (no userName)

steps.title: Given a unique user name and the password from DQ_USER_PASSWORD
When I POST /Account/v1/User without the userName field
Then the response status is 400
And the error code is "1200"
And the error message is "UserName and Password required."

specs.title: SCN-004.2: Creating a user without a user name or without a password is rejected with 400 (no password)

steps.title: Given a unique user name and the password from DQ_USER_PASSWORD
When I POST /Account/v1/User without the password field
Then the response status is 400
And the error code is "1200"
And the error message is "UserName and Password required."

specs.title: SCN-015.1: An empty user name or empty password counts as missing and is rejected with 400 (empty userName)

steps.title: Given a unique user name and the password from DQ_USER_PASSWORD
When I POST /Account/v1/User with an empty userName
Then the response status is 400
And the error code is "1200"
And the error message is "UserName and Password required."

specs.title: SCN-015.2: An empty user name or empty password counts as missing and is rejected with 400 (empty password)

steps.title: Given a unique user name and the password from DQ_USER_PASSWORD
When I POST /Account/v1/User with an empty password
Then the response status is 400
And the error code is "1200"
And the error message is "UserName and Password required."

specs.title: SCN-005: GenerateToken with the correct credentials returns a token

steps.title: Given a user was created through the API
[SEED] account (POST /Account/v1/User)
When I POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken with the correct user name and password
Then the response status is 200
And the token is non-empty
And the status is "Success"
And the result is "User authorized successfully."

specs.title: SCN-016: The token expires 7 days after it was issued

steps.title: Given a user was created through the API
[SEED] account (POST /Account/v1/User)
When I POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken with the correct user name and password
Then expires is a timestamp 7 days after the moment the token was issued

specs.title: SCN-008: Authorized is false before a token is issued and true afterwards

steps.title: Given a user was created through the API and no token has been issued for it
[SEED] account (POST /Account/v1/User)
When I POST /Account/v1/Authorized with the user name and password
Then the answer is false
When I generate a token for that user
[SEED] token for the account (POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken)
And I POST /Account/v1/Authorized with the user name and password again
Then the answer is true

specs.title: SCN-017: Authorized with a wrong password never answers true

steps.title: Given a user was created through the API and a token was generated for it
[SEED] account (POST /Account/v1/User)
[SEED] token for the account (POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken)
When I POST /Account/v1/Authorized with the user name and a wrong password
Then the answer is not true
And the message is "User not found!"

specs.title: SCN-009: Signing in on the web site with an API-created account opens the profile

steps.title: Given a user was created through the API
[SEED] account (POST /Account/v1/User)
And I am on the login page /login
When I sign in with that user name and password
Then the profile page /profile is open
And the profile shows "User Name :" followed by the user name
And POST /Account/v1/Authorized returns true for the account

specs.title: SCN-010: Signing in with a wrong password keeps the user on the login page with an error

steps.title: Given a user was created through the API
[SEED] account (POST /Account/v1/User)
And I am on the login page /login
When I sign in with that user name and a wrong password
Then I am still on the login page /login
And the message "Invalid username or password!" is shown below the form

specs.title: SCN-018: The wrong-credentials message is shown in red

steps.title: Given a user was created through the API
[SEED] account (POST /Account/v1/User)
And I am on the login page /login
When I sign in with that user name and a wrong password
Then the message "Invalid username or password!" is rendered in red

specs.title: SCN-011: Clicking Login with both fields empty does not sign in

steps.title: Given I am not signed in
And I am on the login page /login
When I click "Login" with an empty user name and an empty password
Then I am still on the login page /login

specs.title: SCN-019: Both empty fields are highlighted as invalid after clicking Login

steps.title: Given I am not signed in
And I am on the login page /login
When I click "Login" with an empty user name and an empty password
Then the user name field is highlighted as invalid
And the password field is highlighted as invalid

specs.title: SCN-012: Logging out returns to the login page and the profile no longer shows the user

steps.title: Given a user was created through the API
[SEED] account (POST /Account/v1/User)
And I am signed in on the web site and on the profile page /profile
[SEED] sign in on the web site (UI)
When I click "Logout"
Then I am on the login page /login
When I open /profile
Then the user name is not shown
And the text "Currently you are not logged into the Book Store application, please visit the login page to enter or register page to register yourself." is shown

specs.title: SCN-013: Deleting the account with the user's token returns 204 and the account can no longer get a token

steps.title: Given a user was created through the API and a token was generated for it
[SEED] account (POST /Account/v1/User)
[SEED] token for the account (POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken)
When I DELETE /Account/v1/User/{UUID} with the user's token
Then the response status is 204
And POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken for that user name returns status "Failed"
